custom_logic_notes: TurnGrid is a grid EA that places buy limit and sell limit orders at regular price intervals (grid levels) around a central turning point. When price reverses ('turns'), the grid captures profit from oscillations within the grid range. Grid levels are typically calculated from a base price with fixed pip spacing. The EA manages multiple pending orders simultaneously and closes the grid when an overall profit target is met. Lot sizing may escalate at deeper levels to average entry price. This type of strategy is fundamentally dependent on MT5's pending order management system and grid-level state tracking.
python_conversion_notes: Grid strategies require maintaining a stateful order book with pending limit orders at calculated price levels. Python conversion would need to simulate MT5's pending order lifecycle: placement, triggering on price touch, partial grid closes, and overall profit tracking across all grid positions. The 'turn' detection logic (likely a price action reversal pattern) needs careful porting. Must handle grid expansion/rebuild logic and cumulative P&L calculation across all open grid positions. Strongly recommend mt5 Python integration rather than standalone backtest due to pending order complexity.
